title: The five questions a reviewer asks of every gen AI design

steps.title: Does it need an agent?
steps.note: Pick the lightest design that meets the goal: batch SQL, ai_query, a RAG chain, then an agent

steps.title: Is the corpus ready?
steps.note: Parser by format, clean, then chunk with source, section and page beside each chunk

steps.title: Which half failed?
steps.note: Open the MLflow trace: retrieval first, then generation

steps.title: Who may call what?
steps.note: Endpoint ACL for callers; resources declared at logging for what the chain reaches

steps.title: How do you know it works?
steps.note: Same dataset and scorers before release; monitoring on live traces after

caption: Most DBX-GAI stems test one of these five questions; ask them in this order when reviewing a design.
